purpose: Provenance of the listings and of the development runs. Development evidence only; the verifier container recounts the step-loop listing, regenerates and executes the re-base listings and reruns the experiment itself.
version: v2 of e-man07's 73463878-0c19-4309-a991-749ea525d51c. The step loop (ttstep.c, ttstep.disasm.txt), reference.py (except its docstring), the toy experiments and sections 1-4 of experiment.py are unchanged from 73463878 and consume the same coin stream, so the toy rows of declared_experiment_output equal the source's. tower.c and tower.disasm.txt are removed: the window re-base is now the generated listing set of kernels.py / listings.txt (leaves copied unchanged from e-man07's 7e58d165-ebf6-41aa-8003-2f0a42370b6a), executed in section 5b with a separate coin stream.
rebase_listings: listings.txt was written by kernels.render(kernels.program()) (plus a final newline); experiment.py asserts equality with the generator before executing. No assembler is involved: encodability is checked by kernels.check_encodable on all 1,156 lines.

declared_experiment_output.scope: Full-width BN254 checks of the tower formulas, the tag row identity, the tag certificate and a 120-step walk through the real solve loop; the window re-base executed instruction by instruction on a simulator of the AArch64 subset used, on real GT elements, arbitrary Fp12 elements and edge values; complete-algorithm runs on toy prime-field subgroups only; static recount of the step-loop listing. No production DLP, profiler measurement or acceptance is claimed.

declared_run_environment: python3 -I (CPython 3.12.3), x86-64 Linux, standard library only

offline_toy_run.command: same reference.solve and step_cap, fresh group/target/coins per trial, random.Random(20261111), window 6

earlier_calibration_run_not_the_shipped_.note: cap at model success 0.44 instead of 0.46, random.Random(77)

earlier_declared_layouts_same_seed.note: after reducing the number of full-width GT cases, which shifts the coin stream; the 64-trial row has standard error 0.06

not_claimed: No production-scale walk was run; no instruction count was measured by a profiler or on hardware; the step-loop count is a static count of the clang listing and the re-base count is an executed count on the simulator in experiment.py.
